title: Tower Hill Equestrian Center
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Tower Hill is a 25 acre boarding and training facility conveniently located only 6 miles from Springfield, Illinois. Tower Hill is comprised of two large barns, offering 35 permanent stalls, with additional stalls for show or short-term board available. We have multiple large grass pastures with shelters and automatic watering systems, as well as ten large paddocks which are used for additional turnout. Board
